explain.en: Docker Desktop's virtual disk with all images, containers and volumes. Volumes can hold databases and project data, so Hoardless only shows the size. Use Docker Desktop's own clean-up tools instead.
explain.zh: Docker Desktop 的虚拟磁盘，装着所有镜像、容器和数据卷。数据卷里可能有数据库和项目数据，所以这里只显示大小，请用 Docker Desktop 自带的清理功能。

notes: Location can be changed in Settings > Resources > Advanced > Disk image location; needs a resolver. Sandbox container path: reading it can trigger a privacy prompt. Docker.raw is sparse, so its apparent size overstates real usage.
